commit 42f11a3a2000955325a2206f5281313bc670b4ac
Author:     Boudhayan Bhattacharya <bbhtt.zn0i8@slmail.me>
AuthorDate: Tue Jul 16 03:52:07 2024 +0000
Commit:     Boudhayan Bhattacharya <bbhtt.zn0i8@slmail.me>
CommitDate: Tue Jul 16 03:52:07 2024 +0000

    Bug 1870984 - Replace socket=x11 with socket=fallback-x11. r=dandarnell
    
    
    
    Since bug#1752398, Firefox 121.0, the default became wayland on linux.
    Therefore this socket should be no longer necessary. fallback-x11 gives
    x11, only when the desktop session is not wayland.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D202098

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
index a1fa0efd11f..fd51520aa56 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
@@ -162,7 +162,7 @@ flatpak build-finish build                                        \
         --share=network                                           \
         --socket=pulseaudio                                       \
         --socket=wayland                                          \
-        --socket=x11                                              \
+        --socket=fallback-x11                                     \
         --socket=pcsc                                             \
         --socket=cups                                             \
         --require-version=0.10.3                                  \
title: History 529: Bug 1870984 - Replace socket=x11 with socket=fallback-x11. r=dandarnell
